Connor / Ben —

I reviewed ACME_MSA_Redlines_v7.docx. Summary: most redlines are acceptable; the only items that need either a concession or a short redline are:

1) Section 9 (Data retention): They tightened retention windows. Recommend we accept with an explicit exception for logs used for debugging (retain 90 days).
2) Indemnity, Section 12: Add a narrow carve-out for pre-existing third-party data breaches — we can offer language that limits Redwood liability to direct damages and excludes consequential damages.

If Sales agrees, I can prepare a clean final MSA (MSA_clean_final.pdf) and a POA template for them to sign. For the POA: a scanned, signed POA from Acme's GC will be sufficient for our ops process — notarization is not required unless ACME's policy mandates it. Attached POA_template.docx for Acme to sign.

Attachments: POA_template.docx

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
